specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop 12GB GDDR7 (Advanced Optimus)

price.notes: BBY CA verified 2026-11-24: reg $6,379, sale $4,449. Marketplace DOCK-BUNDLE SET (laptop + 1TB drive/dock) — bundle inflates listed reg price. Marketplace fulfillment/return risk.

offers.name: Acer Predator Neo 18 AI 18" 240Hz Gaming Laptop,Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX,GeForce RTX 5070 Ti,32GB RAM,1TB SSD+1TB Dock Set,4-Zone Backlit Keyboard,Win 11,Black

reviews.quote: Aggregated scoring places it at around 76% overall, indicating a solid but not flawless package.

reviews.outlet: Tom's Guide (sibling Neo 16 AI, same 5070 Ti/275HX/32GB)
reviews.quote: An ineffective cooling system, slow SSD hampered by bloatware, bulky design, and short battery life make the Neo 16 AI a hard sell.

professional.note: No dedicated pro review of the PHN18-72 Neo 18 AI; anchored from NBC-reviewed PHN16-73 (identical CPU/GPU/RAM stack). Honest null for this exact config.

praises: Best-balance Neo 18 tier: 32GB DDR5 + 12GB RTX 5070 Ti + 24-core CPU needs no day-one upgrade
18" 240Hz matte panel — huge canvas, no OLED glare or burn-in worry
Full-TGP 5070 Ti in a chassis with cooling headroom; quiet in Performance mode (Helios 18 platform finding)
USB4/TB4, RJ-45, Wi-Fi 7; RAM/SSD user-upgradeable (unlike soldered rivals)
Bundle throws in a 1TB drive/dock on top of the sale discount
complaints: Bundle reg price is inflated — the same laptop-alone tier discounts to ~$3,200 elsewhere in the lineup
3.5 kg + large brick; this never leaves the desk
Matte IPS panel lacks HDR punch; OLED siblings beat it for media
Acer bloatware/PredatorSense friction on first boot (line-wide)
Short battery life — realistically an UPS-powered laptop

design_philosophy: The 32GB/1TB tier is the intended sweet spot of the Neo 18 AI line — the RAM amount that matches the 5070 Ti's gaming class and the 275HX's core count without paying Acer's memory markup. It's the config Acer's reviewed 16-inch sibling shipped with, stretched to the 18-inch desktop-replacement chassis.
rating_notes: Inferred from NBC 76% PHN16-73 anchor (identical CPU/GPU/RAM spec) + 18" chassis deltas per SHARED-predator.md: screen_size +1.5, portability -1.5, thermals +0.5, matte-IPS display deltas. Dock-bundle caveat in price.notes. No dedicated pro review — honest null.
